surfaces.title: Encyclopedia Index and Topic views
surfaces.current_implementation: P62 transports all 187 owned EDATA images in native and browser builds. P64 adds a production-dormant source-exact 470-by-330 index renderer for both factions, with seven selected category states, three rail held states, native oversized-resource clipping, edge and transparent-pixel rejection, opaque press capture, drag cancellation, and modal click-through blocking. P65 adds the source-derived 356-entry English catalog, seven TEXTSTRA labels and family filters, alphabetical ordering, stable compound-object selection, and scrolling. P66A strictly extracts 348 ENCYTEXT records and 191 ENCYBMAP mappings, reproduces the ordinary, system-picture, and factional mission lookup rules, binds 346 complete topics per faction, and exposes ten source-empty missions without fallback. The browser catalog and index route remain test-only. The production route still uses a replacement four-category window and remains fail-closed from command 0x131. Other localizations, exact font/A0 comparison, topic composition, interactive navigation, contextual entry, visible missing entries, production routing, viewport coverage, and every OBJ-01 cell remain open.
